lines.text: I'm in trouble or out of luck.
I forgot my notes. I'm cooked.

data.mean: I'm in trouble or out of luck.
data.define: Used jokingly when a situation looks bad for you.

example.text: I forgot my notes. I'm cooked.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm cooked' when you merely feel sleepy.
misuse.why: It means you're in real trouble.

data.l1_ex: J'ai oublié mes notes. Je suis « cooked ».
